speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
title: Christ-Centered Unity
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf spoke about “Christ-Centered Unity”.

quotes.text: Recently, Sister Uchtdorf and I attended the baptisms of two of our great-grandchildren. We rejoiced with them as they chose to follow Jesus Christ and made sacred covenants to take upon themselves the Savior’s name, keep God’s commandments, and serve Him. By entering the waters of baptism, they literally followed not only the Savior’s example but also the examples of siblings, cousins, parents, and many trusted friends.
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In other words, when we join the Church of Jesus Christ, we say—humbly, gratefully, and with quiet confidence—that we want to follow our beloved Savior, Jesus Christ. And we want to walk that path together.
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: But the Savior of the world, the Son of God, transcended worldly boundaries and divisions. As Paul said, He “[broke] down the middle wall of partition between us.” He consistently reached out to those who would otherwise be shunned as outsiders. He touched lepers. He praised Gentiles for their faith. He used a Samaritan as an example of compassion. He gathered people from different walks of life and asked them to serve together in positions of trust. He ministered to the poor and rich alike. And today He continues to invite all to come unto Him.
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: And yet the Savior’s work of gathering continues, undaunted. In fact, it is accelerating. And as covenant followers of Jesus Christ, we recognize that we are all brothers and sisters, joyfully participating with Christ in gathering and uniting the great family of God.
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In the Savior’s Church, it is not our political views, culture, or personal interests that unite us. It is our love for God and neighbor, God’s children. It is our commitment to our covenants with Jesus Christ and to His restored gospel. We are “one in Christ.”
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Jesus Christ has the power to change us—you and me—purify us, and unite us. The closer we come to Him, the closer we will come to each other—and the closer we will come to the unity He wants for us.
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Does that sound too lofty? Out of reach? It may seem that way. But then, the Savior is always urging us to reach beyond what seems possible, because “with God all things are possible.”
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: On this path to more unity, let us not miss the unifying power of the sacrament. Each week we gather as fellow disciples of Jesus Christ to renew our baptismal covenant and to remember all the covenants we’ve personally made with God. My dear brothers and sisters, the sacrament can become a fresh starting point for our personal relationship with God and for a greater Christ-centered unity in our lives.
quotes.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
